links.comparator_used: Original published/googled patient education materials on idiopathic intracranial hypertension left unchanged
links.outcome: Readability of prewritten patient education materials, with quality and accuracy maintained
links.effect: SMOG: 5.6 ± 0.6, FKGL: 5.7 ± 0.8, p < 0.001, DISCERN ≥4, Likert misinformation = 1
links.quote: Original published PEMs were rewritten to below a 6th-grade reading level with Prompt C, without a decrease in quality, understandability, or accuracy only by ChatGPT-4 (SMOG: 5.6 ± 0.6, FKGL: 5.7 ± 0.8, p < 0.001, DISCERN ≥4, Likert misinformation = 1).
